The structure of Nd2Al22Mg2 (reduced formula NdAl11Mg) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 26 atoms per unit cell distributed over nine independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all centers, with Al, Mg, and Nd each surrounded by 12 geometric neighbors; Al environments involve varying Al, Mg, and Nd neighbor counts. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 26 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts among 12-vertex Al polyhedra include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing patterns.
